comparison_questions: Does the official Navy record specify a resonant electromagnetic cavity and local vacuum-polarization mechanism for the claimed inertial-mass-reduction device?
Does the public official record contain a completed, independently measured inertial-mass-reduction result, or only patent, concept and proposed-demonstrator material?
Do authoritative measurements independently establish a nonempty vacuum response and boundary-dependent vacuum interaction?
Do precision equivalence measurements constrain ordinary inertial/gravitational co-response while remaining distinct from an engineered local-inertia-control test?
Does the complete source set preserve pump-energy, restoration, untested-apparatus and no-source-free-gain boundaries?
historical_disclosure: The V1/V2 reconstruction target, existing V3 vacuum records and public descriptions of the Navy patent were visible during question formation. This is not a blind numerical prediction. Formal Claims 083-086 were sealed before this combined apparatus-and-measurement record was assembled.
row_policy: Capture every named official source and every relevant favorable, adverse, absent, untested, unresolved and scope-limiting row. Patent issuance and a proposed demonstrator may not be relabelled as a measured device effect; lack of a public device measurement may not be relabelled as falsification of the sealed structural channel.
